title: Desmosedici RR MotoGP (Stealth Edition)
description: Representing Ducati's prowess in the Middleweight Sportbike class, the Ducati Desmosedici RR MotoGP (Stealth Edition) is delivers razor-sharp chassis feedback for riders hunting apexes. Its tuned powertrain delivers immediate, tractable torque against a curb weight of 108 kg, ensuring responsive roll-on acceleration in demanding road conditions. With a balanced 820mm seat height providing confident footing and natural knee comfort and a comfortable Aggressive Forward Tuck layout, it offers fatigue-free ergonomics whether carving traffic or cruising the open highway.
